dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible on the upper mid-body; boundaries consist of dark brown diffuse perimeters transitioning to lighter tan centers with variable edge thickness and non-geometric contours.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, dark, solid-tone spots lacking internal light-to-dark gradients, concentrated primarily along the lower lateral line and the anterior neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangular formation is identifiable by connecting the centroids of the three largest annuli on the dorsal-lateral crest, with a secondary cluster of four smaller blobs forming a rectangular arrangement on the upper mid-flank.
